text: Internal medicine is one of the core disciplines of clinical medicine. It focuses on the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases in various systems of the human body, and emphasizes the cultivation of students' clinical thinking ability and comprehensive diagnosis and treatment ability for common and frequently-occurring diseases in internal medicine. The course combines evidence-based medical evidence with clinical practice to help students master the causes, pathological mechanisms, clinical manifestations, auxiliary examinations and treatment principles of diseases, and ultimately develop the ability to independently handle internal medicine diseases.
